save_draft.source:
def save_draft(ctx: ToolContext, a: dict) -> dict:
    title = a["title"].strip()
    if not title:
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "empty_title")
    tid = ctx.task["task_id"]
    # 取版本号、写文件、改 result.json 都在这个任务的锁里（P1-3、P2-2）；
    # 匹配已有版本不分大小写：NTFS 上 Report-v1.md 和 report-v1.md 是同一个文件
    with ctx.tasks.task_lock(tid):
        # 在任务锁里再核一次状态：/core/tool 在锁外查过，这之间 end 可能已经插进来（F2）
        task = ctx.tasks.locate(tid)[2]
        if task["state"] != "running":
            raise ApiError("TASK_NOT_FOUND", "not_running")
        cached_citation = None
        if task.get("skill") == "defense-opinion":
            cached_citation = citation_check(ctx, a["content"])
            unread = _defense_unread_numeric_citation(
                ctx.tasks, ctx.root, task, cached_citation[1])
            if unread is not None:
                material_id, loc = unread
                unit_name = {"page": "页", "para": "段", "line": "行"}[loc["unit"]]
                loc_text = (f"第{loc['from']}{unit_name}" if loc.get("to", loc["from"]) == loc["from"]
                            else f"第{loc['from']}-{loc['to']}{unit_name}")
                raise ApiError(
                    "INVALID_ARGUMENT",
                    "defense_citation_not_read",
                    f"引用位置{loc_text}尚未由本任务在当前材料版本完整读取。"
                    f"请先用 case_read_material 完整读取材料 {material_id} 的{loc_text}，再保存辩护意见。",
                )
        return _save_locked(
            ctx.tasks, ctx.root, ctx.case_id, task, title, a["content"],
            check_fn=lambda: cached_citation if cached_citation is not None
            else citation_check(ctx, a["content"]),
            coverage_fn=lambda: ctx.tasks.coverage(ctx.root, ctx.case_id, tid),
        )

_save_locked.source:
def _save_locked(tasks, root: str, case_id: str, task: dict, title: str, content: str,
                 *, check_fn, coverage_fn) -> dict:
    """调用方持有来源任务锁；只写一个新版本，并在 metadata 失败时收回本次新文件。"""
    if task.get("skill") == "contract-review":
        mismatch = _rate_ratio_mismatch(content)
        if mismatch is not None:
            raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "rate_ratio_mismatch", mismatch)
    tid = task["task_id"]
    drafts_rel = tasks.rel(tid, "草稿")
    version = tasks.next_draft_version(root, title, ".md")   # 本案同标题接着往上加，不分任务
    rel = f"{drafts_rel}/{title}-v{version}.md"
    target = gate.resolve_write(root, rel, op="save_draft")
    if target.exists():
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "target_exists")
    gate.write_bytes(root, rel, content.encode("utf-8"), op="save_draft")  # 标题是设备名等：闸门拒绝
    try:
        check, cites = check_fn()
        cov = coverage_fn()
        res = tasks.result(root, tid)
        res["drafts"].append({"title": title, "path": rel, "version": version})
        res.update(citation_check=check, coverage=cov, citations=merge_citations(res["citations"], cites))
        tasks.save_result(root, res)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            gate.delete_work_file(root, rel, op="save_draft_rollback")
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 保留原异常；清理失败只记类型
            logs.event("draft", "rollback", status="fail", case_id=case_id, error=type(exc).__name__)
        raise
    # 正式草稿存好了：进度文件清掉（T14 派修；之后模型再回复，progress 会重写，task/end 时再清）
    gate.delete_work_file(root, f"{drafts_rel}/{IN_PROGRESS}", op="save_draft")
    not_fully = [p["name"] for p in cov["partially_read"]] + cov["not_read"]
    return {"path": rel, "version": version, "citation_check": check, "coverage": cov, "not_fully_read": not_fully}

def save_document_ui(tasks, materials, skills_dirs, a: dict) -> dict:
    """界面保存：来源任务结束后，从登记恢复标题并写同标题新草稿版本。"""
    source = documents.locate_source(tasks, a["case_id"], a["path"])
    if contracts.errors("tools/case_save_draft.schema.json", "#/$defs/args",
                        {"title": source["title"], "content": a["content"]}):
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "source_metadata")
    tid = source["task_id"]
    with tasks.task_lock(tid):
        root, task = documents.recheck_stable_source(tasks, source)
        saved = _save_locked(
            tasks, root, a["case_id"], task, source["title"], a["content"],
            check_fn=lambda: _citation_check(
                root, a["case_id"], task, tasks.index_for_task(task), a["content"], skills_dirs),
            coverage_fn=lambda: tasks.coverage(root, a["case_id"], tid),
        )
    return {"task_id": tid, **saved}

_read.source:
def _read(root: str, rel: str, schema: str) -> dict:
        p = gate.resolve_internal(root, rel, op="task")
        data = contracts.read_json(p)
        if schema == "files/task.schema.json" and isinstance(data, dict):
            data.setdefault("route", "local")  # T38：旧任务单缺字段按本地，内存兼容
        contracts.validate(schema, "", data)
        return data

def add_read(self, root: str, task_id: str, rec: dict) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            data = self._read(root, self.rel(task_id, "reads.json"), "files/reads.schema.json")
            data["reads"].append(rec)
            self._write(root, self.rel(task_id, "reads.json"), data, "files/reads.schema.json")

"""T18：辩护意见引用必须由本任务当前材料版本的完整读取支撑。

本文件只定义有限的红灯测试和正向对照，不修改产品实现、旧测试或测试辅助层。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib

from t8_helpers import Env, fail, ok


DEFENSE_SKILL = "defense-opinion"
TASK_PARAMS = {"thinking": "中", "window": "32K", "max_tokens": 2048}


def _selected_task(env: Env, session: str, skill: str | None) -> str:
    """通过公开的 /api/task 选择 skill，再由真实 /core/task/begin 建运行中任务。"""
    req = {
        "case_id": env.case_id,
        "session_id": session,
        "entry": skill,
        "skill": skill,
        "inputs": [],
        "params": TASK_PARAMS,
    }
    ok(env.client.post("/api/task", json=req), "api/task_create.schema.json")
    return env.begin(session)["task_id"]


def _material_env(tmp_path: pathlib.Path, text: str) -> Env:
    source = tmp_path / "事实材料.txt"
    source.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return Env(tmp_path / "case", {"事实材料.txt": source})


def _reads(env: Env, task_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    return env.read_json(task_id, "reads.json", "files/reads.schema.json")["reads"]


def _snapshot(env: Env, task_id: str) -> tuple[bytes, tuple[tuple[str, bytes], ...]]:
    task_dir = env.task_dir(task_id)
    result = (task_dir / "result.json").read_bytes()
    drafts_dir = task_dir / "草稿"
    drafts = tuple(sorted(
        ((p.relative_to(drafts_dir).as_posix(), p.read_bytes()) for p in drafts_dir.glob("*.md")),
        key=lambda item: item[0],
    ))
    return result, drafts


def _assert_citation_denied(env: Env, task_id: str, content: str, name: str, loc: str,
                            private_text: str) -> None:
    materials = env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_list_materials", {})["materials"]
    material_id = next(m["material_id"] for m in materials if m["name"] == name)
    before = _snapshot(env, task_id)
    body = fail(env.tool(task_id, "case_save_draft", {"title": "辩护意见", "content": content}),
                "INVALID_ARGUMENT")
    error = body["error"]
    message = error["message"]
    assert isinstance(message, str) and message
    assert material_id in message and loc in message
    assert "读取" in message
    assert name not in message
    assert private_text not in message
    assert len(message) <= 500
    assert _snapshot(env, task_id) == before
    assert env.read_json(task_id, "task.json", "files/task.schema.json")["state"] == "running"


def test_t18_main_search_only_numeric_citation_denied_without_side_effects(tmp_path):
    """搜索命中不是读取；未读引用必须拒绝，且不落草稿、不改 result。"""
    env = _material_env(
        tmp_path,
        "第一行 借款经过\n第二行 红色雨伞是检索命中\n第三行 还款经过\n第四行 其他事实\n",
    )
    try:
        task_id = _selected_task(env, "t18-main-search-only", DEFENSE_SKILL)
        env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_search", {"query": "红色雨伞"})
        assert _reads(env, task_id) == []

        _assert_citation_denied(
            env,
            task_id,
            "辩护意见正文〔事实材料 第2行〕",
            "事实材料",
            "第2行",
            "红色雨伞",
        )

        # 放在第一个主断言之后：即便旧实现同时缺少区间并集核对，也只产生一个主 RED 节点。
        env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_read_material", {"name": "事实材料", "start": 2, "end": 2})
        env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_read_material", {"name": "事实材料", "start": 4, "end": 4})
        _assert_citation_denied(
            env,
            task_id,
            "辩护意见正文〔事实材料 第2-4行〕",
            "事实材料",
            "第2-4行",
            "还款经过",
        )
    finally:
        env.close()


def test_t18_main_wrong_task_or_old_version_read_does_not_authorize(tmp_path):
    """别的任务读过、或本任务读过旧版本，都不能支撑当前辩护意见保存。"""
    env = _material_env(
        tmp_path,
        "第一行 红色雨伞\n第二行 还款经过\n第三行 其他事实\n",
    )
    try:
        defense_task = _selected_task(env, "t18-main-identity-defense", DEFENSE_SKILL)
        other_task = _selected_task(env, "t18-main-identity-other", None)
        env.tool_ok(other_task, "case_search", {"query": "红色雨伞"})
        env.tool_ok(other_task, "case_read_material", {"name": "事实材料", "start": 1, "end": 1})
        assert _reads(env, other_task)
        assert _reads(env, defense_task) == []

        _assert_citation_denied(
            env,
            defense_task,
            "辩护意见正文〔事实材料 第1行〕",
            "事实材料",
            "第1行",
            "红色雨伞",
        )

        env.tool_ok(defense_task, "case_search", {"query": "还款经过"})
        env.tool_ok(defense_task, "case_read_material", {"name": "事实材料", "start": 2, "end": 2})
        stale_reads = _reads(env, defense_task)
        assert any(r["from"] <= 2 <= r["to"] for r in stale_reads)

        (env.root / "事实材料.txt").write_text(
            "第一行 红色雨伞\n第二行 还款经过已更新\n第三行 其他事实已更新\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        ok(env.client.post("/api/materials/scan", json={"case_id": env.case_id}),
           "api/materials_scan.schema.json")
        _assert_citation_denied(
            env,
            defense_task,
            "辩护意见正文〔事实材料 第2行〕",
            "事实材料",
            "第2行",
            "还款经过已更新",
        )
    finally:
        env.close()


def test_t18_positive_correct_actual_read_allows_same_content(tmp_path):
    env = _material_env(tmp_path, "第一行 红色雨伞\n第二行 还款经过\n第三行 其他事实\n")
    try:
        task_id = _selected_task(env, "t18-positive-correct-read", DEFENSE_SKILL)
        env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_search", {"query": "还款经过"})
        env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_read_material", {"name": "事实材料", "start": 2, "end": 2})
        content = "辩护意见正文〔事实材料 第2行〕"
        saved = env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_save_draft", {"title": "正确读取", "content": content})
        assert saved["version"] == 1
        assert (env.root / saved["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8") == content
    finally:
        env.close()


def test_t18_positive_complete_inclusive_range_allows(tmp_path):
    env = _material_env(tmp_path, "第一行 借款\n第二行 交付\n第三行 催款\n第四行 其他\n")
    try:
        task_id = _selected_task(env, "t18-positive-range", DEFENSE_SKILL)
        env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_search", {"query": "交付"})
        env.tool_ok(task_id, "case_read_material", {"name": "事实材料", "start": 1, "end": 3})
        content = "辩护意见正文〔事实材料 第1-3行〕"

def _edge_end(env: Env, task_id: str, reason: str) -> str:
    expected = {"budget": "budget_stopped", "completed": "completed", "error": "failed"}[reason]
    value = ok(
        env.client.post(
            "/core/task/end",
            json={
                "task_id": task_id,
                "reason": reason,
                "model_calls": 7,
                "tool_calls": 2,
                "elapsed_s": 3,
            },
        ),
        "core/task_end.schema.json",

    assert value == {"status": expected}

    result = env.read_json(task_id, "result.json", "files/result.schema.json")
    assert result["status"] == expected
    assert result["usage"] == {"model_calls": 7, "tool_calls": 2, "elapsed_s": 3}

from __future__ import annotations

MESSAGES: dict[str, str] = {
    "INVALID_ARGUMENT": "请求参数有误",

    "MATERIAL_NOT_READY": "这份材料还不能读取（待识别或处理失败）",

    "BUDGET_EXCEEDED": "已达到本次任务的上限，已保存草稿",
    "SERVER_UNREACHABLE": "无法连接服务器，请检查网络",
    "KEY_INVALID": "Key 无效或已停用，请联系管理员",
    "SERVER_BUSY": "服务器繁忙，排队已超过 5 分钟，请稍后再试",
    "CONTEXT_TOO_LONG": "内容超出模型上限，请缩小范围或调大窗口",
    "OUTPUT_TRUNCATED": "输出达到上限，已保存为草稿，可调大\"最大生成量\"后继续",
    "TIMEOUT": "本次生成时间过长，已停止并保存草稿",
    "HOST_NOT_ALLOWED": "不允许连接该地址",
    "PREP_UNAVAILABLE": "395 暂时不可用，恢复后会自动继续",
    "CANCELLED": "已取消",
    "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE": "工作台服务未启动，请稍后重试",
    "INTERNAL": "内部错误，请重试；多次出现请联系技术支持",
    "OFFICE_DIR_NOT_SET": "请先在设置中指定日常办公文件夹",
    "CONVERTER_UNAVAILABLE": "无法把文件转成 PDF，请在 Word 或 WPS 中另存为 PDF 后放入案件文件夹",
    "TEMPLATE_MISSING": "缺少模板文件，请联系管理员",
    "ENGINE_FAILED": "发票整理未完成，请查看下方的输出信息",
    "ENGINE_BUSY": "发票整理正在进行中，请等它完成再操作",
    "PLAN_NOT_CONFIRMED": "请先确认办案结果",
    "ORIGINAL_HAS_REVISIONS": "原文件含未处理的修订，请先接受或拒绝后再生成",
    "CASE_CARD_INVALID": "案件卡片（工作区/wiki/case.json）已损坏，请重新生成 wiki",
}


class ApiError(Exception):
    """业务错误：接口按 HTTP 200 + 失败体返回。`reason` 只给日志用，不含路径和内容。"""

    def __init__(self, code: str, reason: str | None = None, detail: str | None = None):
        """detail：给律师看的具体说明（如哪份材料、为什么），替换该码的通用提示；不进日志。"""
        if code not in MESSAGES:
            raise ValueError(f"未知错误码 {code}")
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code = code
        self.reason = reason
        self.detail = detail

    @property
    def message(self) -> str:
        return self.detail or MESSAGES[self.code]


def fail_body(code: str, message: str | None = None) -> dict:
    return {"ok": False, "error": {"code": code, "message": message or MESSAGES[code]}}

"""给 AI 的工具 case_*（Spec 4.4、20.4；契约 contracts/tools/）。本卡实现 8 个；case_calc_sentence 由 T24 接入，
case_archive_match、case_save_archive_plan 归 T23。

所有工具只作用于当前任务所属的案件；参数先按工具契约的 $defs/args 校验（不合格 INVALID_ARGUMENT），
工具参数里没有路径，材料一律用 case_list_materials 给出的材料名。单次返回不超过 8000 字。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Callable

from .. import contracts
from ..errors import ApiError


@dataclass
class ToolContext:
    root: str
    case_id: str
    task: dict
    tasks: object       # case.task.TaskStore
    materials: object   # case.materials.Materials
    skills_dirs: tuple = ()   # Skill 目录：出处核对按任务 Skill 的 kind 区分 G 类（T10）；空则按 analysis

    def index(self) -> dict:
        return self.tasks.index_for_task(self.task)

    def material_by_name(self, name: str) -> dict:
        for m in self.index()["materials"]:
            if m["name"] == name:
                return m
        raise ApiError("MATERIAL_NOT_FOUND", "unknown_material")


def _registry() -> dict[str, Callable[[ToolContext, dict], dict]]:
    from . import archive, drafts, edit_list, inputs, materials, search, sentence
    return {
        "case_list_materials": materials.list_materials,
        "case_read_material": materials.read_material,
        "case_search": search.search,  # T9 替换 T8 的临时实现（裁决 1548 第 2 条）
        "case_read_input": inputs.read_input,
        "case_read_wiki": inputs.read_wiki,
        "case_save_draft": drafts.save_draft,
        "case_suggest_wiki": drafts.suggest_wiki,
        "case_save_edit_list": edit_list.save_edit_list,
        "case_calc_sentence": sentence.calc_sentence,  # T24
        "case_archive_match": archive.archive_match,  # T23
        "case_save_archive_plan": archive.save_archive_plan,
    }


TOOLS = tuple(_registry())


def run(ctx: ToolContext, tool: str, args: dict, validate_result: bool = True) -> dict:
    impl = _registry().get(tool)
    if impl is None:
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "unknown_tool")
    schema = f"tools/{tool}.schema.json"
    if contracts.errors(schema, "#/$defs/args", args):
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "args_contract")
    value = impl(ctx, args)
    if validate_result:
        contracts.validate(schema, "#/$defs/result", value)
    return value
